name: components-boundaries
description: The import boundaries AGENTS.md and the package CLAUDE.md files state, as policy-violation findings. Relative imports across packages and the charts layering are .fallowrc.json's zones; this pack covers what a zone cannot see: package-name and external specifiers.

rules.message: SvelteKit resolves this only inside an app, and src/lib ships. Take it as a prop or from getComponentsContext() (AGENTS.md § Common pitfalls).
`effect` is not a peer of the Svelte packages. Only the /entity-form entry reaches it, and only through @thomasfosterau/effect-forms-svelte (packages/components/CLAUDE.md § Boundary).
The form library is an optional peer reached only from the /entity-form entry; importing it anywhere else makes every consumer install it.

Navigation-only menus must not reach bits-ui's DropdownMenu (~30 KB gzip on every page, #129). The dropdown parts live in ui/DropdownMenu.svelte and ui/dropdown/*.svelte and reach MenuItem / MenuSeparator through context.
Effect stays inside packages/charts/src/spec, and never in a published type (packages/charts/CLAUDE.md § Boundary).
@thomasfosterau/charts is independent of the Svelte packages (packages/charts/CLAUDE.md § Boundary).
The Svelte packages do not import @thomasfosterau/charts; the Svelte Chart in /charts is a separate, series-based component.

packages/mapbox consumes the core only through its published /canvas entry (packages/mapbox/CLAUDE.md § Boundary). The bare root import is banned by the root vite.config.ts's no-restricted-imports, which can match it exactly.
